title_en: Exclusive Preview: How Star Trek: The Original Voyages' Unseen Images Celebrate 60 Years of Kirk and Spock
summary_en: Star Trek: The Original Voyages offers a deep dive into the making and legacy of the original series, and we've got an exclusive preview of this gorgeous book.
body_en:
Plenty of books have been written on the phenomenon that is Star Trek, but Penguin Random House aims to deliver the definitive resource in the form of Star Trek: The Original Voyages - A Visual History. This massive art book will give fans an incredibly thorough look at the making and legacy of the classic original series.
Ahead of its November 2026 debut, IGN can reveal an exclusive preview of Star Trek: The Original Voyages. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
Star Trek: The Original Voyages is written by Kyle Newman and Jeff Bond and features a foreword by the one and only William Shatner. This 416-page hardcover features a wealth of behind-the-scenes photos, concept art, and other images covering the debut of the series in 1966 through the release of Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country in 1991.
Here's the official description of the book:
Star Trek: The Original Voyages - A Visual History is published by Ten Speed Press and will be released on November 10, 2026. You can preorder a copy on Amazon .
For more, see our breakdown of the Star Trek 60th anniversary panel at SDCC 2026 .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
